news.title: Empire Metals, Vast Resources, Rockfire Resources, Oxford Nanopore Technologies, Scancell
news.summary: Empire Metals Ltd (AIM:EEE, OTCQX:EPMLF) has upgraded its Pitfield project in Western Australia to 8.16 billion tonnes, confirming it as the world's largest titanium resource. That includes a first Measured Resource of 374 million tonnes at a solid 5.8% grade. Vast Resources PLC (LSE:VAST, FRA:D9A) has completed its takeover of Gulf International Minerals, adding a producing gold and silver mine in Tajikistan. It's also raised around £7.5 million to fund the next stage of development following its re-admission to London's AIM. Rockfire Resources PLC (LSE:ROCK) has hit fresh high-grade zinc and germanium at its Molaoi deposit in Greece. The best intersection came in at 6.2% zinc and over 15 grams per tonne germanium. Oxford Nanopore Technologies PLC ( LSE:ONT) jumped 4% after setting a target of $700 million in annual revenue by 2030. It's also aiming to break even on adjusted earnings by 2027. Scancell Holdings PLC (AIM:SCLP, OTC:SCNLF, FRA:SCP) has won UK approval to run a late-stage trial of its melanoma drug iSCIB1+. That follows FDA approval back in January, with more applications now under way. Follow us and subscribe on YouTube, our social channels, and on proactiveinvestors.co.uk.
